title: A community you help shape
dek: Meet peers. Share ideas. Make something happen.
alt: Students and community participants at an IBSC activity
caption: An activity shared by the IBSC Student Association.
paragraphs: The Student Association brings students together through events, workshops and networking. Participation offers a way to build friendships, develop leadership and contribute your voice to campus life.
From cultural exchange to student gatherings and service, shared experiences are part of learning to communicate across cultures.

title: A different classroom, a wider perspective
alt: An overseas experience featured by IBSC
caption: An overseas experience featured by IBSC.
paragraphs: International experiences offer a different classroom and a chance to put communication into practice. Explore host institutions and courses, then discuss how an exchange could fit your academic plan.
Ask the program office about the opportunities currently available. The exchange guide below explains preparation, nomination and the steps before departure.

title: Communication through contribution
dek: Put learning into practice with others.
alt: IBSC students leading a Christmas activity at Bao-Sheng Elementary School
caption: IBSC students taking part in a Christmas activity at Bao-Sheng Elementary School.
paragraphs: IBSC’s featured activities include visits to Bao-Sheng Elementary School, where students take part in English teaching and Christmas activities. These encounters connect communication with participation in the wider community.
Service learning also involves reflection. Review the activity process and service-log guidance before you begin, and confirm eligible activities with the university.
